description: This Java source file implements the NotificationReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to check for unread notifications, update notification statuses, and retrieve notifications for a user within the Apache Fineract project. It manages cache for notification response headers, executes SQL queries to fetch notification data, and uses pagination and search parameters for flexible data retrieval.

classes.name: NotificationMapperRow
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set rows to NotificationMapperData objects.

classes.name: NotificationDataRow
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set rows to NotificationData objects.

methods.name: hasUnreadNotifications
methods.description: Checks if the user has any unread notifications by potentially updating cache or querying the database.

methods.name: updateNotificationReadStatus
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read for the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: getAllUnreadNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all unread notifications for the user, applying search parameters.

methods.name: getAllNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all notifications for the user, including read and unread, with support for search parameters.

methods.name: getNotificationDataPage
methods.description: Helper method to execute SQL with search parameters and retrieve a page of notification data.

methods.name: checkForUnreadNotifications
methods.description: Executes SQL query to determine if the user has unread notifications.
